decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of low cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also utilizes the Companion mechanic with Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional value. The key strategy is to swarm the board with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, while using spells like Infuriate and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to boost their power. Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional reach, allowing the deck to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Utilizing the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring allows for an additional source of mana while maintaining a consistent threat on the battlefield. Cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero provide early aggression, while spells like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage help pump up creatures for even more damage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently with a combination of creatures and direct burn spells.

The main focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is aggressive gameplay, using powerful creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. With a mix of high-powered creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester, along with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, the deck aims to apply pressure and control the board early on. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing for a streamlined aggressive strategy that can quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures and using combat tricks to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. It includes efficient creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Monastery Swiftspear, as well as spells like Monstrous Rage and Infuriate to pump up the creatures and push through damage. The deck also utilizes powerful lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins to maximize damage output. Additionally, the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides an extra mana source and adds consistency to the deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures and spells early in the game, combined with a toolbox of removal spells and hand disruption to control the opponent's board. The deck also includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Pawpatch Formation to generate additional value and synergies with the combo pieces. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with unexpected threats and versatile plays, using creativity and resourcefulness to outmaneuver and outpace them.

This deck focuses on using a combination of low-cost spirits and disruptive spells to maintain control of the board while applying pressure to the opponent. By utilizing creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom alongside disruptive spells like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents. The deck also includes a small number of utility lands like Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire and Otawara, Soaring City to provide flexibility and resilience. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

The primary strategy of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive approach using low-cost creatures and combat tricks. By establishing a wide board presence early on, the deck aims to apply constant pressure while leveraging synergies between its white creatures. Cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Brave the Elements help to enhance the deck's aggressive capabilities and protect its creatures from removal spells. The inclusion of Mutavault adds an extra level of versatility and resilience to the deck's game plan.

Utilizing a diverse array of spells and strong card advantage, this deck seeks to control the game through the powerful Niv-Mizzet Reborn. By tutoring up various answers with cards like Bring to Light and Leyline Binding, while generating value from cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Fabled Passage, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a slow, methodical game plan. With a focus on flexibility and adaptability, the deck looks to grind out wins through incremental advantages and powerful late-game threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive Rakdos creatures and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan and deal consistent damage. The main strategy is to apply early pressure with efficient threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross, while also disrupting the opponent's hand using cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to efficiently deal damage early on while maintaining card advantage with cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan. The deck also utilizes the ability of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion to provide additional mana and flexibility. With cards like Reckless Rage and Heartfire Hero, this deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and finish them off before they have a chance to stabilize.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. Utilizing a combination of cheap creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and powerful removal such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, this deck aims to maintain board control while dealing consistent damage to the opponent. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress adds another layer of disruption to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck benefits from powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games quickly.

This deck relies on a diverse range of multicolored cards, focusing on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control tool. The deck contains a variety of removal spells, ramp cards, and card advantage engines to control the game and out-value the opponent. With the help of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck can generate additional value by blinking permanents. The deck aims to stabilize the board, draw cards, and eventually overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and creatures.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of powerful creatures and removal spells. With cards like Leyline Binding and Vanishing Verse to deal with threats, and Overlord creatures to apply pressure, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent. Zur, Eternal Schemer acts as a powerful finisher and source of card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells. Ultimately, the deck's goal is to establish dominance over the opponent through strategic play and efficient resource management.

The deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while utilizing cards that synergize with the Zur, Eternal Schemer. By employing a combination of removal spells and counterplay, the deck aims to control the battlefield and outmaneuver the opponent. The main creatures in the deck, Overlord of the Floodpits, Overlord of the Hauntwoods, and Overlord of the Mistmoors, work together with Zur to create powerful synergies and further assert board control. The deck also includes a variety of lands and support cards to ensure consistency and flexibility in managing threats and resources.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost creatures in a Weenie White aggro strategy. By establishing a board presence early on and utilizing cards like Brave the Elements to protect your creatures, you can aggressively attack and apply pressure to your opponent. Thalia's Lieutenant and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben provide anthems and disruption to further enhance your board position. With efficient creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Coppercoat Vanguard, this deck aims to win the game quickly through efficient combat and overwhelming numbers.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a Rakdos color combination, utilizing efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board while deploying powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also incorporates versatile lands like Mutavault and Blightstep Pathway to ensure mana consistency. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and threats, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.
